faqItems.a: Put a 6-digit PIN on the first page; anyone opening the link needs it to read on. To keep the letter out of other users' Universe feed, turn off "Share to the Universe" when you create it.

faqItems.q: How long can it be?
faqItems.a: Each Message page holds up to 800 characters, and you can add several pages.

faqItems.q: Can I read it aloud?
faqItems.a: Yes. Record or upload up to 1 minute of audio per page.

faqItems.q: Is it free?
faqItems.a: Free to create and preview. Pay 99 THB once to activate; the link doesn't expire, and you can still edit it at no extra cost.

faqItems.q: Can I send it with a paper letter?
faqItems.a: Yes. Print the QR code and put it in the envelope or card.
